result_text:
I fixed both defects in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/generators/statichtml/LogicalComponentsReportGenerator.java`. The module compiles, but I didn't run any tests or add a new one.

1. **Group dependencies crash:** in `getGroupDependencies`, the reverse-direction branch read the count from `key1`, which isn't in the map, hence the NullPointerException. It now reads from `key2`, so the reverse count is added to the existing link. A 3-file dependency from Group 1 to Group 2 plus a 2-file one back gives a single Group 1 → Group 2 link labelled 5.
2. **Zero lines of code:** in `getFromDependencyCoverageSvg`, the percentage is now 0 when the referring component has no counted lines. The text then shows "0%". I didn't check how `SimpleOneBarChart.getPercentageSvg` draws a 0% bar, so I haven't confirmed it renders as a minimal bar.
